claim_one_line: THREE FROM THE CUSPS, run as sealed (97fdce6d; sL-7): no finite abelian cover of m004's levels M2-M6 carries a generation-shaped count of sm:B1515's frame at a lambda = 1 pulled-back member, at any class, in either order -- not three and not one. Routes T and L (sharing no code) read all 119,347 terms (I(W1 (x) chi), I(Lambda^2 W1 (x) chi)) at every class (163,507 readings each) and agree on every one (D5 = 0); Part 0 (507 chi = 1 terms against sm:B1515's census) passed in both; route C (the permutation module) agrees in all 264 readings of covers read whole. The census reads 68,596 counts per route over every subgroup of every level: Lambda^2 is 0 on M2-M5 and in [-28, 0] on M6; W >= -1 everywhere, and -1 only at the interior class of M6's 120 two-class members on covers containing nu^4, where the group <nu^4> already carries two Lambda^2 terms of -1, so Lambda^2 is -2 or -4 there and (-1, -1) never occurs. Five of nine predictions held (P1, P2, P3, P7, P8; P4-P6 and P9 failed). Disclosed: sm:B1535's Theorem C, committed as a blind prediction at 5c6a4225 before the read-out, holds at all 163,507 readings of each route; after the run, the members at kappa^5 = 1 read from the sealed terms on every finite abelian cover (110,956 counts per route) carry no generation-shaped count. 0 of 19 stays 0.
